reviews.title: Terrible Customer Support – Refund Refused
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Picsart. My annual subscription automatically renewed on August 26, charging me AED 332.09. I requested a refund immediately on the same day because I had no intention of renewing for another year.

Apple rejected my refund request and advised me to contact Picsart, explaining that the refund had been declined on the developer’s side.

However, Picsart’s customer support repeatedly responded with the same generic message, claiming they have no authority to issue refunds and directing me back to Apple.

I’ve contacted both companies multiple times over nearly two months, and neither has provided a solution. Instead of investigating my case or offering meaningful assistance, Picsart continues sending identical responses.

I’m extremely disappointed with the lack of accountability and customer care. I expected much better from a paid subscription service.

I would strongly recommend being cautious with annual subscriptions and automatic renewals. I am still waiting for a proper resolution and a refund.

reviews.title: Doesn’t load my gallery
reviews.text: I do love this app and how simple it is to use. I used to use it a lot years ago and recently I downloaded it again to create collages so I can print them out. Almost 95% of the time it doesn’t load my gallery and I have to exit out of the app multiple times and go back in and try again and then sometimes if the gallery does upload the most recent screenshots or photos don’t show up. Which means I have to try over and over again exiting out of the app and going back in to see if it will show up and then it’ll be stuck in a loop of not loading my gallery again. 5% of the time maybe it’ll load the second or third try but that’s very rare experience for me and it’s very upsetting and annoying because you would expect an app like this to load your photos more expeditiously. It feels like I’m working with an old piece of technology every time I’m spending up to 20 minutes to finally get my photos to load. I haven’t found another app yet that does what I want like Picsart does it so therefore I tolerate it but it’s literally the most annoying thing ever. If I do find another app, I will most likely leave Picsart unless they fix this issue.
